div.div:
Subnet plan (/16 VPC, e.g. dev 10.0.0.0/16, prod 10.10.0.0/16)
Public /24 x.x.0-3.0 251 IPs/AZ
Data /24 x.x.10-13.0 251 IPs/AZ
Intra /24 x.x.20-23.0 251 IPs/AZ
Private /20 x.x.32-95.0 4,091 IPs/AZ
Spare: x.x.96.0 - x.x.255.255
Each tier has its own fixed range, so adding an AZ can't collide with another tier. AZs are pinned by AZ ID (use1-az1/az2/az4), not by name.

div.div:
Route tables
public-rt (shared)
0.0.0.0/0 → IGW
::/0 → IGW (if IPv6)
private-rt-<az> (one per AZ)
0.0.0.0/0 → NAT GW in same AZ
::/0 → egress-only IGW (if IPv6)
172.31.0.0/16 → pcx
S3 / DynamoDB prefix lists → gateway VPCE
data-rt (shared, isolated)
local + 172.31.0.0/16 → pcx only
no internet, no S3 route
intra-rt (shared, isolated)
local + S3 / DynamoDB gateway VPCE
Default VPC route tables
VPC CIDR → pcx (return path)

text.tspan: S3 / DynamoDB prefix lists → gateway VPCE

div.div:
Guardrails
• Default SG: all rules removed
• Default NACL: adopted (drift visible)
• No auto-assigned public IPv4
• Peering CIDR overlap → plan fails
• State: S3, encrypted, native lock
• CI: fmt, validate, tflint, checkov,
plan → approval → apply
